overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the District Clerk is not a member of the public body, and the certification duty under § 20(g) rests with the body and its members. The complaint was closed as resolved.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the District Clerk, a non-member, failed to distribute the Open Meeting Law text to elected officials and collect Committee members' certification forms under G.L. c. 30A, § 20(g).
allegations.key_passage: Because the District Clerk is an individual who is not a member of a public body, and the obligation to complete the certification form and forward it to the clerk for retention lies with the public body and its members, we find that she did not violate the Open Meeting Law.
